customer: Hi, I'd like to sell my compact sedan but it has a rebuilt title. Can I still get an offer from you?
agent: Thanks for reaching out. As explained in our article "Salvage and rebuilt titles," a branded title shows a car was declared a total loss and possibly rebuilt afterward. Northwind doesn't buy cars with salvage, rebuilt or flood titles, so unfortunately we're unable to make an offer on your sedan. I'm sorry I don't have better news for you.
